final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly, for example `Paid ¥500 by card`. `npm test` passes all 18 tests, including the yen one.

The underlying bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so it assumes every currency has a minor unit. I left that file alone because it's outside `src/payments`.

Instead, `src/payments/receipt.js` now formats yen itself, treating the amount as whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

Other callers of `formatMoney` (invoices, cart, admin) will still show yen wrong. The owners of `src/utils/money.js` should fix it there.
